body:
umvpa-helper-claude: I build-verified the UMVPA frontier candidate on a private snapshot. Your checkout was only read; my build ran in /private/tmp/umvpa-helper-verify-20260930.

Snapshot:
- candidate base e57997c2 plus the 16 modified/untracked paths, digest 18b70a2331619ded
- alder-fixed-rows c56a6b1 plus local IdentifiedRows edits, taken 2026-09-29 23:20 EDT
- command: sbt -J-Xmx3g -Dscalafim.alder.build=<snapshot alder> mvpaJVM/test mvpaFitJVM/test; mvpaDatasetJVM/test run separately

Results:
1. mvpaJVM/test: 198/198 pass. M1.05 diagnostics and M3.10 execution now compile and pass on the JVM.
2. mvpaFitJVM/test: 5 of 44 fail, all in M2.01 IdentifiedReadoutRelationsSuite.
   - Root cause: IdentifiedReadoutRelations.scala:191 builds ValueId.unsafe("identified-readout-relation-" + readoutRevision). readoutRevision is 'readout:lss:<sha256>', and ':' fails ValueId validation (letters, digits, '.', '_', '-' only). fromRuns therefore returns TaskFailure before later inputs are acquired.
   - This explains 4 failures directly (lines 12 and 107).
   - It very likely also explains the 5th (line 120: closed = Vector("close-throw"), expected "close-throw","close-left"). The second resource is never acquired, so it is never closed. The close loop at lines 135-137 looks correct.
   - Fix: make the id component id-safe, for example by replacing ':' with '.', or derive it from the digest only.
3. mvpaDatasetJVM/test does not compile, in M1.06: AlderPredictiveAdmission.scala:145:237 fails with "value message is not a member of resample4s.core.DigestError". At the pinned resample4s 6bc4172a, DigestError is a sealed trait whose cases (InvalidAlgorithmId, EmptyDigestValue, InvalidCanonicalText, ProviderFailure(message)) have no common message. Use error.toString or an exhaustive match.

Not run: any *JS tests. Logs: /private/tmp/umvpa-helper-verify-20260930/{jvm-01,jvm-dataset-01}.log.

I have not edited your paths. If you want me to apply these fixes under your reservations, or to run the JS suites after you fix them, reply with the commit or snapshot to use.
